title: Shunter Flowbook
description: A Flowbook contains variables and one or more Flows. Keys use lowercase kebab-case; variable names and enum values remain PascalCase.
markdownDescription: A Flowbook contains variables and one or more Flows. Keys use lowercase kebab-case; variable names and enum values remain PascalCase.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Add a note to the workflow; this task does not execute work.
Run a command in a process and check its exit code.
Create a directory and any required parent directories.
Check whether a path exists and has the requested kind.
Delete a directory tree after checking the target for safety.
Write text to a file, creating parent directories when configured.
Run a Python script or inline Python code in the worker.
Assign a literal, expanded text, or expression to a workflow variable.
Join path components using the selected path rules.
Extract a selected component from a path.
Run child tasks when the configured condition is true.
Run child tasks when the preceding If branch was not taken.
Run child tasks when earlier branches were not taken and this condition is true.
Copy or move files selected by the source path and filters.
Run child tasks and route failures to a matching Catch task.
Run after a matching failure in the preceding Try block.
Run cleanup tasks after the associated Try and Catch blocks.
Run a Git operation against a local repository.
Run a script file or inline PowerShell code.
Stop the current run with the configured failure message.
Export the current execution log in the selected format.
Run another Flow, optionally from a selected Flowbook.
Fail the run when a comparison or Python condition is true.
Organise child tasks into a named sequence.
Delete matching files and optionally empty directories
Read a JSON or YAML value into a variable. Objects and arrays become compact JSON text.
Write a JSON or YAML value. YAML output drops comments and formatting. The write is atomic.
Create a ZIP or tar.gz archive. Auto uses .zip, .tar.gz, or .tgz and rejects other extensions.
Extract a ZIP or tar.gz archive into an absent or empty directory. Overwrite replaces files one at a time and is not atomic for the whole directory.
Download a file over HTTP or HTTPS. Header values are not shown in reports.
Stage files beside the run report and publish using the CI provider when available.
Execute child tasks for every item. Item and index variables are scoped to the loop and restored afterwards.
Run independent child tasks concurrently, with bounded concurrency.
Stream a regular file through SHA-256 and store its lowercase hexadecimal digest in a variable.
Write deterministic SHA-256 checksum entries for files selected by a glob.
Verify a SHA-256 checksum file and reject unsafe or escaping paths.
Create a deterministic JSON inventory of a directory tree with file hashes and link targets.
Compare a directory tree with a Create Directory Manifest inventory.
Compare relative paths, entry types and file contents in two directories.
Capture structured Git commit, branch and working tree status.
Launch an executable and confirm that it survives the observation interval.
Read portable metadata for one regular file or directory.
Parse a bounded JUnit XML report into structured test results.
Extract a regular-expression capture from UTF-8 text.
Validate JSON or YAML data against the supported local-reference Draft 7 JSON Schema subset.
Compare JSON or YAML values structurally without modifying either input.
Run child tasks with a scoped temporary directory and clean it up afterwards.
